    Description
    AccountType

    AppConfig
    The AppConfig class represents a centralized configuration manager for the Typing Duel application.
    AuthService
    The AuthService class provides authentication and session management functionality for the Typing Duel application.
    BaseScreenPanel
    BaseScreenPanel defines the shared visual style and helper utilities used by the application's Swing screens.

    The DifficultyRotator class is responsible for managing and rotating words across different difficulty levels in a cyclical order: EASY → MEDIUM → HARD → repeat.
    EndlessMode
    EndlessMode.java
    ExitConfirmPanel
    ExitConfirmPanel shows a confirmation screen before the application closes.
    FileDataStore
    Central file-backed persistence service for Typing Duel data.
    FileDataStore.WordEntry
    Represents a single word entry loaded from words.json.
    ForgotPasswordPanel
    ForgotPasswordPanel handles the password recovery workflow for existing users.
    GuardianControlPanel
    GuardianControlPanel provides the guardian or teacher management interface.
    GuardianLoginPanel
    GuardianLoginPanel provides the protected login flow for parent and teacher accounts.
    GuardianService
    The GuardianService class provides all functionality related to guardian (parent/teacher) control within the Typing Duel application.
    HighScoreEntry
    Represents a single immutable entry in the global high score leaderboard.
    HighScorePanel
    HighScorePanel displays leaderboard and player performance information.
    HighScoreTable
    Stores and maintains the global high score leaderboard.
    HighScoreTable
     
    LevelSelectPanel
    LevelSelectPanel lets the player choose which gameplay mode or difficulty to enter.
    LoginPanel
    LoginPanel provides the main authentication screen for Typing Duel.
    LogoutConfirmPanel
    LogoutConfirmPanel asks the player to confirm that they want to end the current session.
    Main
    Launches the Typing Duel desktop application.
    MainFrame
    MainFrame is the top-level application window for Typing Duel.
    MainMenuPanel
    MainMenuPanel is the public landing screen of Typing Duel.
    NFRChecker
    Performs automated runtime checks for selected non-functional requirements.
    PhaseManager
    Coordinates attack and defend phase flow for a Typing Duel match.
    PhaseManager.GamePhase
    Represents the two alternating combat phases in a match.
    PhaseManager.PhaseResolution
    Immutable summary of the outcome of resolving a single attack or defend phase.
    PhaseManager.PowerUp
    Represents power-up effects that can modify the next phase resolution.
    Player
    Represents a player account in the Typing Duel system.
    PlayerMenuPanel
    PlayerMenuPanel displays the main dashboard for a logged-in player.
    PlayerStats
    Stores the lifetime gameplay statistics associated with a Player.
    ProgressionService
    The ProgressionService class handles all game progression logic for the Typing Duel application.
    RegisterPanel
    RegisterPanel handles local account creation for new users.
    Score
    Represents a score record for a specific difficulty tier.
    ScoreManager
    Manages persistence and retrieval for the global high score table.
    ScreenManager
    ScreenManager coordinates navigation between the application's Swing screens using a CardLayout.
    ScreenManager.ScreenAware
     
    SettingsPanel
    SettingsPanel provides the in-game configuration screen for player-adjustable preferences such as audio volume, brightness, and colourblind-friendly HP bar palettes.
    StandardGameplayPanel
    StandardGameplayPanel represents the main gameplay screen of Typing Duel.
    Statistics
    Stores aggregate gameplay statistics for a player or session summary.
    StatService
    The StatService class is responsible for managing player performance statistics across game sessions.
    TestResource
    Simple utility for verifying that packaged application resources can be resolved.
    TutorialPanel
    TutorialPanel provides a step-by-step gameplay guide for new players.
    TypingEngine
    The TypingEngine class is the core backend component responsible for handling real-time typing logic in the Typing Duel application.
    TypingEngine.TypingListener
    Listener interface for receiving typing-related events.
